workshoptitle: Build the WeMakeDevs Discord Learning Bot with Oracle Autonomous Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Workshop overview, architecture, outcomes, and prerequisites.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to OCI and select the workshop tenancy and region.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Prepare OCI Compute, Autonomous Database, and HTTPS
tutorials.description: Create the OCI host and database, transfer the wallet securely, and configure Nginx HTTPS with a reserved-IP certificate.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Download the Bot and Configure Discord and OpenRouter
tutorials.description: Download the bot ZIP, configure Discord and OpenRouter, register six commands, and verify startup.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Set Up Agent Profiles
tutorials.description: Run the agent-store schema in SQL Actions, configure the wallet, and verify profile persistence.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Run the Bot as a Service and Verify Its Features
tutorials.description: Run systemd, check the HTTPS endpoint and Gateway, exercise configured features, and review operations.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Find help with LiveLabs workshop issues.
